spintaxSection.title: Real-Time Spintax Playground
spintaxSection.subtitle: The Spintax engine randomizes message variations so Meta's spam filters never detect recurring hashes.

featuresSection.title: Engineered for maximum reliability.
featuresSection.subtitle: Distributed infrastructure combining Go Microservices, Redis 7.x Streams, and Next.js 16.
featuresSection.f1Desc: Spintax regex parser, ChatPresenceComposing human typing simulation, 3-7s dynamic jitter delay, account warmup quotas, and goroutine concurrency throttling.
featuresSection.f2Desc: Drops millions of story updates, call offers, and read-receipt events at line 1 to keep Go runtime RAM stable below 150 MB.
featuresSection.f3Desc: Isolated modular frontend architecture (IAM, WhatsApp, Campaign, Contact, Subscription, Finance, Support, Content, Admin) ready for multi-domain scale.
